name: Moonrise Mini Golf
summary:
Start at the Moonrise Clubhouse, then step through a portal to one of five 18-hole courses. Four are free to play; Glowtown is an add-on.

LANTERN COVE: Golden hour by the sea. Bank off a giant conch, time the tide and finish under the lighthouse.

NEON SHROOM FOREST: A glowing night. Roll through root tunnels, down a log flume and up the towering Mother Shroom for the finale.
